items.text: the Feedback only box looks like a box on a phone (it was a black circle)
the bug report has a Feedback only box. Tick it for an idea or a wish; it is kept apart from bugs, so only real bugs go to be reproduced and fixed
a clearer thank-you after sending

bringing the sound back works now. Every restart was failing once a water scene had played (a piece of the old sound engine stayed behind), so the sound stayed off and the chip had nothing that worked
if a restart ever fails, the chip stays up so Reset is there, instead of vanishing
typing a bug report on a phone no longer brings up the computer's Keys button
when the sound dies with nothing changed, a chip appears top right: Sound restarts the sound, Reset reloads the app straight back to your scene (no cover), and the bug reports it from there
a sound that goes completely silent while a beat, bytebeat or loop plays now counts as lost too, not only a stalled clock
on a phone, the bug report has its own button on the screen, beside the duck
the water surface is a material now, its own part of a scene beside the pattern, the style and the sound, and Auto play can change it as a fourth change (Material)
what drives the surface: your touch, the sound, the pattern (ripples along the G-code's cuts as the field runs, and the field carrying the water along), or any mix. In the Water row

the material's colors: tint (the depth), glint (the highlights) and caustic (the gathered light), each following the lines, the second color or the ground. Colors and the pattern driver come with Pro: everyone can see them; with a key they work
Deep Current and Stream use them
17 new scenes, 52 in all. Seven for water (Harbor, Pod, Rain on Glass, Deep Current, Hydrophone, Stream, Still Pond): each brings its water, its bed and its surface, and goes quiet under them

type scenes that play their own words: Loop · Swim · Play (the first scene now, starting on any of the three), Swim · Shallows, Play Shuffle and Word by Word, each with its own stay and morph. Type your own word and it wins
five scenes on colored grounds (Deep Blue, Terracotta, Sea Green, Bone, Violet), and Dice: Weather, where the dice rolls every 4 seconds until you leave it
collections. Scenes has a row of them (Water, Sound, Touch, Type, Lens & Glow, Color, Unsteady, G-code), and Auto play can run just one
every scene now has a second line color and a touch color, the color your finger paints in; the second color comes grain by grain, by motion or in time, at different speeds
the robot starts with a tour of eight scenes, 15 seconds each: type, the G-code underneath, its modes, your touch, a beat, a bytebeat, water, ink on paper
Life Leads Speed, Flicker Hatch, Byte: Chord Drift and Hatch + Travel were nearly empty frames; they read now
a scene you save keeps its water, its surface, its sound, its words and the dice's tempo, and so does a scene you send as a link
the robot's signal is clean rings now: thin arcs rise from its antenna, widen and fade, one on each beat; with reduced motion, one still arc
the flow readout says ×3, not ×3.0
the Color mixer no longer jumps when a color changes, a color animates or the scene moves on: it stays where it is and only its values change
the Color mixer as wide as the bar: the picker on the left (always open), the swatches on the right with Related and Recent each in a row, and the animation in one row along the bottom
Blend, how the lines lay onto what is drawn (normal, add, screen, multiply, overlay, difference). It comes with Pro: everyone can see it; with a key it works, and a scene keeps its blend
